meta.title: Sales Dashboard
meta.subtitle: Record your sales here — they update stock right away and, if you want, go into Cash Flow as income.

newSale.title: Record sale
newSale.hint: The sale posts as revenue in Cash Flow and deducts stock. On connected channels, the listing is updated too.
newSale.lowStockWarn: Only {available} in stock — the balance will hit zero.
newSale.pinSubtitle: Enter your 4-digit PIN to record the sale
newSale.hintNoCashflow: The sale is recorded only in the Sales panel and deducted from stock — your Cash Flow balance doesn't change.
newSale.cashflowToggleOn: The sale is recorded as income (Sales category).
newSale.cashflowToggleOff: The sale won't go to Cash Flow, the Dashboard or reports.

byChannel.title: Sales by channel
byChannel.ordersUnits: {orders, plural, one {# order} other {# orders}} · {units} units

breakEven.title: Break-even point
breakEven.subtitle: Revenue needed this month to cover the budget (Cost Center, Bills and Taxes)
breakEven.noBudgetShort: No budget this month. Add one in Cost Centers, Bills or Taxes.

chart.title: Daily sales
chart.ariaLabel: Bar chart: daily sales for the month by channel — details in the table below
chart.caption: Daily sales by channel
chart.daysBelow: {count, plural, one {# day with sales below target} other {# days with sales below target}}

topProducts.title: Best-selling products
topProducts.subtitle: Revenue in the period × current stock
topProducts.empty: No sales recorded in the period.

stockControl.title: Stock control
stockControl.footer: {count, plural, one {# product registered.} other {# products registered.}} Each sale deducts stock automatically and syncs the linked channels.

pricing.title: Pricing Calculator
pricing.intro: Find the sale price that secures your target margin after paying taxes and the variable costs per unit (packaging, shipping, commission).
pricing.productCostHint: How much the product costs you (purchase or production).
pricing.variableCostHint: Packaging, label, shipping and channel commission — in R$ per unit.
pricing.taxesHint: Taxes on the sale — Simples, ICMS, etc.
pricing.marginHint: Net profit you want on the sale price.
pricing.infeasible: Taxes + margin add up to 100% or more of the price. No price is possible — lower the margin or the taxes.
pricing.markupNote: Markup of {markup}× over the total cost (product + variable).

salesList.title: Sales
salesList.emptyHint: Sales recorded here or received from marketplaces show up in this list.

config.title: Sales settings
config.marketplaceHint: Choose, per channel, whether incoming orders are recorded as income in Cash Flow or stay only in the Sales panel. Stock is deducted either way.
config.onDesc: Orders go into Cash Flow (income + fees).
config.offDesc: Orders stay only in the Sales panel — they don't affect Cash Flow, the Dashboard or reports.
config.futureOnly: Applies to new orders. Sales already recorded stay where they are.

pdv.title: Point of sale
pdv.subtitle: Sales Dashboard — manual entry
pdv.popupBlocked: The browser blocked the print window. Allow pop-ups for this site.

open.title: Open register
open.hint: Open the register to start selling. At the end of the shift, closing checks what came in for each payment method.
open.openingCashHint: Counts toward the expected cash amount at closing.
open.pinSubtitle: Enter your 4-digit PIN to open the register

terminal.searchPlaceholder: Type the name or SKU and press Enter to add
terminal.emptyHint: Search stock above or fill in the fields below.
terminal.shortcuts: Shortcuts: F2 searches products · F4 completes the sale · click a row to select the item to cancel.
terminal.invalidItem: Enter the description and a quantity greater than zero.
terminal.emptyCart: Add at least one item before completing.
terminal.confirmClear: Clear all items from this sale?

sales.title: Sales in this register ({n})
sales.empty: No sales in this register yet.

payment.title: Payment
payment.installmentsHint: In Cash Flow the sale is posted at its full amount on today's date.
payment.cashflowOn: The sale is posted as income (Sales category).
payment.cashflowOff: The sale stays only in the Sales Dashboard · it does not go to Cash Flow, Dashboard or reports.

receipt.title: Sales receipt
receipt.offCashflow: This sale was not posted to Cash Flow.

close.title: Register closing
close.hint: {n, plural, one {# sale} other {# sales}} in this shift · opening change {opening}. Enter the amount counted for each payment method.
close.countCash: Count the cash in the drawer and enter the counted amount.
close.notesPlaceholder: E.g.: cash withdrawal of R$ 100 at 3 pm, difference explained…
close.pinSubtitle: Enter your 4-digit PIN to close the register

report.expectedHint: Expected cash = opening change + cash sales.

proLock.title: The POS is a Pro plan feature
proLock.body: The POS — multi-item sales, Pix, card with installments, receipts and shift cash closing — is available on the Pro plan.
